name: A · Cobalt Signal / 钴蓝信号

prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-resolution, exceptionally crisp, professional FULL PRODUCT DESIGN ATLAS for the self-hosted server monitoring product named exactly "romi". It is an ORIGINAL proposed visual redesign, not a screenshot of any existing competitor. Flat front-facing digital UI, no devices, perspective, photographs, stock illustrations or fake browser chrome. Canvas 3840 x 2160 landscape or the largest native landscape resolution. Render one coherent atlas with twelve clearly separated complete UI mini-screens in a precise 4-column by 3-row grid, plus a narrow title and palette bar. Every panel must look like a real implementable Chinese-language monitoring web app at desktop/tablet scale, not like a poster or a marketing website. Do not crop panel boundaries. Make the small typography as sharp and legible as possible, prioritize concise labels and numerical data over paragraphs.
The title bar says "romi" and the direction name, plus "产品视觉原型 · 示例数据". Lowercase romi is the only product brand. Use Chinese modern sans-serif like Noto Sans SC for interface labels, refined grotesk for romi, tabular mono digits for live values. Maintain identical typography, icon family, 8px spacing rhythm, buttons, inputs, state pills, surfaces, charts and corner radius throughout this whole board.
All 12 panels are required, with compact numbers and clearly readable Chinese panel headings:
01 "公开概览" — overall 12 nodes, 11 online, 1 offline, current upload/download, six fictional nodes such as SG-Edge-01, NRT-Core-02, FRA-01; CPU/memory/disk meters, traffic, online state. Do not show IP addresses or credentials.
02 "节点详情" — SG-Edge-01, CPU 14%, memory 46%, disk 31%, 24-hour CPU/memory/network charts with clear units and legends; TCP latency chart, time tabs, renewal date.
03 "节点管理" — functional left navigation and a dense readable table with node name, private/public badge, status, traffic quota, cost/expiry and compact edit/credential actions. New nodes default private.
04 "延迟探测" — TCP task table with target names, ports, interval, assigned nodes, latency trend; button to add a TCP task. No ICMP/HTTP selector because they are not implemented.
05 "通知" — Telegram and Webhook configuration cards, offline grace 3 min, traffic threshold 80%, expiration 7 days, masked secrets, test notification action. Do not invent incident feeds, arbitrary CPU rules or email/SMS integrations.
06 "数据维护" — SQLite size, retention days, backup download, restore and cleanup actions with differentiated destructive state and confirmation affordance.
07 "主题" — local built-in theme preview, light/dark samples, external theme uploads visibly disabled by default and a short trusted-theme notice; NOT a theme marketplace.
08 "安全" — GitHub OAuth configuration and sessions list, logout/revoke session action; NOT multi-user RBAC, TOTP or passkeys.
09 "站点设置" — site name, public status page OFF, external country lookup OFF, clearly labeled switches and save action.
10 "登录" — intentional restrained romi sign-in panel, emergency password field and optional GitHub sign-in, clean full-page composition using the same visual family.
11 "凭证与续费" — two compact realistic dialogs: one-time node token display shown only as "••••••••" with copy/rotate actions and "仅本次显示", plus billing amount, currency, cycle and expiry controls. No real secrets and no invented automatic renewal payment.
12 "移动端" — two narrow mobile UI frames within this tile, public overview and node detail, using compact headers and stacked meters; same design system.
The fictional statistics are demonstration data, not real measurements or product guarantees. All current capabilities above must be present; don't add shell/terminal execution, service incident SLA, maps, AI assistants, multi-user roles or GPU panels. Keep important states indicated by BOTH text/icon and color. Use a controlled dominant brand ink and one deliberate accent; status colors green/amber/red are small semantic exceptions. Adapt editorial color discipline and strong hierarchy for a usable information-dense app, no paper grain over data, no halftone on charts, no gradients, no glass, no glows, no decorative squiggles, no excessive rounded pill cards. Large, bold, deliberate brand-colored fields should make this vivid and distinctive while calm neutral surfaces keep data clear.
DIRECTION: A · Cobalt Signal / 钴蓝信号
